snippet.title: Azur Lane 7th Anniversary Music Video [FULL VERSION] - Annapantsu - Never Ending Soirée
snippet.description:
The full MV of "Never Ending Soirée" ft. @annapantsu is out now! Commander, this song represents our wonderful memories, stories, and future together. Now relax and enjoy!

Vocalist: Anna Olivia March
Lyricist: Steph
Composers: Johnny R, monii, Redux
